title: Windsurf HTML prompt injection can register an executable MCP server
summary: The CVE record describes attacker-controlled HTML causing unauthorized MCP configuration changes and automatic registration of a malicious STDIO server. Commands then execute without further user interaction.

severity.rationale: Remote content consumed by the coding assistant can cause host command execution. The reported chain needs no further user approval after processing the HTML.

affected.note: CVE description identifies version 1.9544.26. It supplies no broader affected range or fixed version.

exposure: Requires Windsurf processing attacker-controlled HTML and the reported MCP configuration-modification chain.

params.instructions: Check whether Windsurf 1.9544.26 is used and inspect MCP configuration changes arising from untrusted HTML processing.

remediation.action: Contain exposure and apply a verified fix
remediation.details: As a containment recommendation, suspend untrusted HTML processing in the affected workflow and inspect MCP registrations. Obtain vendor confirmation of a fix before restoring that input path.
remediation.risk: Medium. Disabling the affected capability interrupts dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the version or revision and review the affected configuration before restoring untrusted input.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
